events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place from August 15-18, 1969, on a dairy farm in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock Remembered
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Woodstock Festival, which kicked off this day in '69. Three days of peace, love, and music that changed everything. What was your favourite performance from the original line-up?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the death of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have been 91.

angles.name: The King Remembered
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the King, Elvis Presley, who would have been 91. His music continues to define generations. What's your all-time favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the iconic rapper Tupac Shakur, who was shot in Las Vegas in 1996 and died six days later, and would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55 this year. His impact on music and culture remains undeniable. What's the Tupac track that still resonates with you?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the death of guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84.

angles.name: Jimi's Genius
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84 this year. His revolutionary guitar work continues to inspire. Which Hendrix riff is your go-to?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on September 26, 1969, in the UK, and on October 1 or 3, 1969, in the US.

angles.name: Abbey Road Legacy
angles.copy: On this day in '69, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. From the legendary cover to the timeless tracks, it's a masterpiece. What's your favourite moment from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders' legend still rocks. What's your favourite track from Chrissie and the band?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Iconic Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock and roll swagger. What's your favourite Liam moment, solo or with Oasis?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal album 'Imagine' was released on September 9, 1971, in the US, and October 8, 1971, in the UK. The single 'Imagine' was released in the US on October 11, 1971, and in the UK on October 24, 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: On this day in '71, John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A timeless message that resonates just as powerfully today. What does the song 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: First iPod Released Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the day the first iPod dropped? This day in 2001, Apple changed music forever. How many songs did you cram onto your first iPod?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in London in 1962.

angles.name: 007 Day
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Celebrating the iconic 007 and his incredible cinematic legacy. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the legendary John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's the Lennon track that means the most to you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the comedy genius, John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us so many iconic moments. What's your favourite John Cleese character or sketch?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as the 'White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Classic
angles.copy: On this day in '68, The Beatles dropped the incredible 'White Album'. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece. Which track from the double album is your absolute favourite?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the death of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie's Unmatched Voice
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's the Queen song that truly showcases his genius?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Milestone
angles.copy: On this day in '65, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that pushed their sound in new directions. What's your top track from this classic?
